asset: Primm's Castle dungeon map (redo: eleven missing walkways)
in-game use: The node map of Primm's Castle (the final dungeon)
replaces: MAP-PC of Batch 19: every room and landing spot is right and 30 of the 41 links have a painted walkway. Eleven links have none, so the game still draws a plain line for each of them.
description: Repaint of the Batch 19 MAP-PC, everything unchanged (the rooms, the landing spots, the 30 walkways, the sky), plus ELEVEN more walkways, each a white-and-gold arched bridge or stair like the others, from the first room's landing spot to the second's, always leading right: 1) the Gilded Pantry (top of column 1) DOWN to the Portrait Gallery (column 2, second from the top); 2) the Courtyard of Perfect Hedges (bottom of column 1) DOWN to the Garden of Uniform Flowers (bottom of column 2); 3) the kitchen-like Lab Notes room (top of column 2) DOWN to the Hall of Mirrors (middle of column 3); 4) the Portrait Gallery UP to the red Barracks (top of column 3); 5) the Grand Foyer (column 2, third from the top) UP to the Hall of Mirrors; 6) the Garden of Uniform Flowers UP to the Hall of Mirrors (a long stair); 7) the Hall of Mirrors UP to the violet Archives (top of column 4); 8) the Correction Ward Cells (bottom of column 3) UP to the Ministry office (middle of column 4); 9) the Ministry office UP to the greenhouse Seed Vault (top of column 5); 10) the Safe Room bedroom (column 5, third from the top) UP to the Royal Stair (column 6, second); 11) the Royal Kitchens (bottom of column 5) UP to the Clocktower (column 6, third). The first two matter most: they are on the all-allies route. No lettering.
references: now_MAP-PC.jpg (Batch 20 Refs: the Batch 19 map in the game, with the eleven drawn lines on it), plan-primm-castle.jpg (the layout)
